thread:
leo_sales: ACME POC blocked during demo. Embeddings return 403 invalid_project_claim. Customer insists key is the one on the project page. Can we triage?

devx_ian: Can you paste the exact curl and response? Any request_id from their logs helps.

leo_sales: They sent: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_trial_ZZZ' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -H 'X-Redwood-Org: acme-eu' \n  -H 'X-Redwood-Project: demo' \n  -d '{"model":"rw/emb-small","input":"test"}'```
Response: `{"error":"invalid_project_claim","status":403,"hint":"token project 'demo-prod' != header 'demo'"}`

mina_eng: Looks like token claim is demo-prod but header says demo. Usually caused by copying an older project key or CI injecting different creds.

leo_sales: Customer says only one key exists in their vault. Could be they have a stale env var on their host.

devx_ian: Fastest fix: rotate/create project-scoped key in Console -> Projects -> demo -> Keys -> Create and update app. Temporary workaround: remove X-Redwood-Project header so server uses token claim (not recommended).

mina_eng: Also, we tightened enforcement last week; pre-policy global keys are now blocked. If they can't rotate, provide request_id and we can decode server-side or add a short-lived routing exception (needs ops approval).

leo_sales: Got request_id=req-2026-ACME-901. Opening support ticket. Asking them to rotate and pause retry replays to avoid 429 spikes.

support-bot: support-bot: ticket #SUP-2026-501 created for req-2026-ACME-901, assigned to eng-triage.

devx_ian: Share this dev tip with them: make sure Authorization token and X-Redwood-Project/X-Redwood-Org header are in sync. Example for node: ```fetch(url, { headers: { 'Authorization':'Bearer sk_...', 'X-Redwood-Org':'acme-eu', 'X-Redwood-Project':'demo-prod' } })```

mina_eng: If rotation doesn't work, have them paste JWT header+payload (redact signature) or we decode from request_id.

leo_sales: I'll tell them to rotate and report back. Will follow up here with new curl. Thanks all :thumbsup:
